'''Daiv''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] brother of [[Lair]] and of [[Benedict Vidkun]]'s [[Benedict Vidkun's wife|wife]].<ref name="sotes">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

He lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and worked at the construction firm that got the contract to [[Xizor's Palace]].<ref name="sotes" /> He installed the [[rat-gate]] there.

Sometimes he would provide Vidkun with detailed plans of sewer levels, which Vidkun would sell to suspicious groups, and share the profits with him.<ref name="sotes" />
